:::{#def-identity}
#### Identity

An **identity**
[@wikipedia_identity_mathematics]
is an equation between two expressions
that holds for every value of its variables
in a stated [set](https://morrison-lab.github.io/mcs/sets.html#def-set), such as the [real numbers](https://morrison-lab.github.io/mcs/number-systems.html#def-real-numbers).

:::
